definition_en: a bitter yellow-green fluid made by the liver; figuratively, anger or bitterness
core_image: 肝下深绿的苦液，一路苦到舌尖与脾气
scene: 体检单上写着肝区检测结果。Anger flooded the essay with bile.
sceneCN: 这里 bile 是「怨怒、刻毒」（第 2 个义项：文中的尖刻怨气）；句意是满腔怒火让这篇文章浸透怨毒。

derivatives.zh: bile 加形容词后缀，义为「胆汁多的；易怒的；坏脾气的」
医学形容词，义为「胆的；胆汁的」
bilious 加 -ness，义为「坏脾气；胆汁质」
同族概念词，义为「易怒的」，同出希腊 cholē「胆汁」

senses.title: The liver's bitter fluid
senses.definition: the bitter yellow-green digestive fluid produced by the liver and stored in the gallbladder
senses.definitionCN: 由肝产生、储于胆囊的黄绿色苦味消化液
senses.example: The liver secretes bile to help digest fats.
senses.exampleCN: 肝分泌胆汁帮助消化脂肪。
senses.why: Latin bilis named the fluid medieval medicine thought to sour temper.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bilis 指这种被中世纪医学认为败坏脾气的液体。

senses.title: Anger and bitterness
senses.definition: bitter anger, especially in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 尖刻的怨怒，多见于言辞或文章
senses.example: Anger flooded the essay with bile.
senses.exampleCN: 满腔怒火让这篇文章浸透怨毒。
senses.why: If excess bile soured the temper, bile itself became temper.
senses.whyCN: 既然胆汁过多败坏脾气，bile 便直接转指怨怒。

senses.title: Irritability of temperament
senses.example: Old age had not sweetened his bile.
senses.exampleCN: 岁月并未让他的坏脾气变柔和。
senses.why: The humour theory fixed bile as the anger-fluid of the body.
senses.whyCN: 体液学说把胆汁固定为体内的「怒之液」。

senses.title: Bitterness in criticism
senses.definition: harsh, bitter quality of criticism or commentary
senses.definitionCN: 批评或评论的辛辣尖刻
senses.why: Written venom is the same sour fluid metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 笔端的毒液仍是那股「苦胆水」的比喻。

senses.title: Bile in medicine and anatomy
senses.definition: the substance as treated in physiology, as in bile ducts and bile salts
senses.definitionCN: 生理学中的胆汁，如胆管、胆盐等术语
senses.why: Anatomy keeps the fluid sense at its literal core.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学保持胆汁的字面义为核心。

senses.title: Bitterness of taste or tone
senses.definition: any bitter taste, or a sour tone of voice
senses.example: He spoke the apology without a drop of bile.
senses.why: The taste of bile flavors both tongue and tone.
senses.whyCN: 胆汁之苦同时调味舌尖与语气。

senses.title: Spite in personal relations
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间的恶毒怨气
senses.example: The family quarrel left years of bile between the brothers.
senses.exampleCN: 家庭争吵让兄弟间的怨毒延续多年。
senses.why: Stored anger, like stored bile, turns poisonous.
senses.whyCN: 积压的怒气如积存的胆汁，终成毒。

senses.title: Bile in humour theory
senses.definition: one of the four humours of pre-modern medicine
senses.definitionCN: 前现代医学四体液之一（黄胆汁）
senses.example: In Galenic medicine, bile governed the choleric temperament.
senses.exampleCN: 在盖伦医学中，胆汁掌管暴躁型气质。
senses.why: The humour theory is the bridge between fluid and fury.
senses.whyCN: 体液学说是「液体」通向「怒火」的桥。

intro.en: Bile is Latin bilis, the gall fluid, taken straight into English.
intro.cn: bile 直接取自拉丁语 bilis，即「胆液」。

items.en: the root bel- may have meant to swell, to flow; origin uncertain.
items.cn: 词根 bel- 或指「膨胀、流动」；来源不确定。

items.en: bilis meant bile, gall; origin uncertain even to the Romans.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bilis 意为「胆汁、苦胆」；其来源连罗马人也不清楚。

items.en: bilis was one of the four humours, ruling the choleric temper.
items.cn: 中世纪医学中 bilis 为四体液之一，主宰暴躁气质。

items.en: fiele and bilis forms passed into medieval French learning.
items.cn: 相关词形经中世纪法语学术语汇流传。

items.en: English took bile in the 16th century, both fluid and temper.
items.cn: 英语于 16 世纪借入 bile，兼指液体与脾气。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bilis root or the spelling; the near-meaning group gathers bitterness words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bilis 词根或拼写；近义组汇集苦毒类词。

entries.definitionCN: 胆汁质的；易怒的——同根形容词

entries.definition: of the bile or bile ducts

entries.definitionCN: 言辞刻毒——争执语境常用

normalIntro.en: Bile is the liver's bitter fluid, and by metaphor, bitter anger.
normalIntro.cn: bile 是肝的苦液，借喻为苦涩的怒气。

normal.en: The liver makes bile; the gallbladder stores it.
Full of bile describes bitter writing.
normal.cn: full of bile 形容怨毒的文字。

normal.en: Bile duct is the medical term.
Choleric shares the Greek bile root.
normal.cn: choleric 与之共享希腊「胆」根。

abstract.en: See green liquid rising like temper.
abstract.cn: 看绿色液体如怒气上涌。

abstract.en: Taste the word's bitterness on the tongue.
Picture a critic squeezing gall instead of ink.
abstract.cn: 想象评论家挤的不是墨水而是苦胆。

examples.en: Anger flooded the essay with bile.
examples.cn: 满腔怒火让这篇文章浸透怨毒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆偶」——一点小事就摆脸色，苦胆全挂在脸上。

root: 拉丁语 bilis「胆汁」（更早来源不确定），16 世纪进入英语；中世纪体液学说视其为四液之一、主怒，故词义由苦液延伸为怨怒与坏脾气；同根词 bilious、biliary，希腊同族 cholē 产出 choleric。

sensesIntro.en: One bitter fluid of the liver flavors both medicine and temper.
sensesIntro.cn: 肝中一味苦液，同时调味医学与脾气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: green bitterness rising from the liver
core.cn: 核心意象：自肝上涌的绿色苦液

intro.en: Bile is a Latin noun borrowed whole.
intro.cn: bile 是整体借入的拉丁名词。

latinIntro.en: The bilis family in Latin and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bilis 词族及其英语后裔。

items.meaningCN: 苦胆；怨毒（日耳曼近义词）
